Neighbour effects are an uncalibrated map of this run's audience overlap (same category cannibalises, a different category is treated as complementary footfall, and the effect scales with the neighbour's fit); no extra Qloo call. Units are treated as a line of neighbours, about 100 m apart or on one mall floor; that distance is not measured. With negotiable rent only the symmetric part of those effects changes the total. The 2023-2024 Chicago backtest found no measurable gain, so this is not a survival forecast. Empty units are not part of those checks: this search does not move a tenant into a vacant unit. Only the concepts that received an audience-overlap check carry a neighbour effect, and a run checks at most two, so other concepts contribute 0.
